name: Dunatetétlen (Hungary)
description: Horizontal stripes of blue, white, blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dunatetétlen (a green shield with a house and a white wavy stripe) above a scroll inscribed DUNATETÉTLEN.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
